description: Defines the DataObjects_Clients class for managing client (advertiser) records in the database, including CRUD operations, account management, and audit logging.

classes.name: DataObjects_Clients
classes.description: Represents the 'clients' table, managing client/advertiser data, including creation, update, deletion, and account linkage.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates that auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID, which is the client ID.

methods.name: getOwningManagerId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID of the manager that owns this advertiser account, or the admin account ID if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates a new account, optionally creates a user, and inserts the client record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the client record, manages user creation, and updates the account name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the client record and associated account.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array with the client's name as description.
